d: In this video, Firstpost explains Iran’s shocking warning to Europe as tensions escalate between Tehran and Western nations. Iran has threatened Italy, Germany and other European countries that allow US military bases to be used for attacks against Iran. Could Europe become the next target in the US-Iran conflict? What does Tehran’s ultimatum mean for NATO, European security, US military bases in Europe, the Strait of Hormuz crisis and rising West Asia tensions? Is a wider regional war looming? Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America this week.
